hero.title: Sayme
hero.description: Sayme connects talents with their fans on a single platform, where users can ask a talent of their choice to record a personalized video gift

meta.scope: Discovery → User flow map → Brand Guidelines → Flows creation

parts.label: Discovery
parts.text: Clients could find the right talent and see the price, delivery time, and expected result before ordering. Video profiles and a short flow kept that path simple.

parts.label: Creator workflow
parts.text: Talents handled incoming requests, recording, delivery, and earnings in one workspace, from the first task through client review.

parts.label: Two apps
parts.text: Separate client and talent experiences shared navigation, patterns, and a compact component system built for React Native.

beats.label: Problem
beats.text: The MVP required separate client and talent experiences while keeping design and development effort manageable.

beats.label: Research
beats.text: We compared both user journeys and identified shared navigation, interface patterns, and reusable components.

beats.label: Iterations
beats.text: We created a compact component system and cross-platform architecture optimized for React Native.

beats.label: Outcome
beats.text: Two distinct experiences built from one consistent foundation, reducing complexity and making the product easier to scale.

beats.label: Problem
beats.text: Clients needed to quickly find the right talent and understand the price, delivery time, and expected result without navigating a complex marketplace.

beats.label: Research
beats.text: We mapped the key decision points in the customer journey and defined the minimum information required before placing an order.

beats.label: Iterations
beats.text: We introduced video profile cards, tag-based recommendations, clear pricing, estimated delivery times, and a focused ordering flow.

beats.label: Outcome
beats.text: A simple path from talent discovery to ordering a personalized video, without overbuilding the MVP with a complex content feed.

beats.label: Problem
beats.text: Talents needed to manage incoming requests, record videos, deliver orders, and track earnings without switching between multiple tools.

beats.label: Research
beats.text: We mapped the complete creator workflow and prioritized the actions required to fulfil an order quickly.

beats.label: Iterations
beats.text: We designed a task-based dashboard, in-app video recording, client review, order management, ratings, and billing tools.

beats.label: Outcome
beats.text: A single workspace where talents could complete the entire order cycle with minimal effort.
